untyped-authors.definition: Legacy authors is the source-credit text as recorded on a card; it is attribution evidence, not a normalized person identity or an edition key.
untyped-authors.disposition: Preserve the observed string and its shape; do not split, reconcile, or infer person records from it.

untyped-chapter_number.definition: Legacy chapter_number is the observed ordinal for the named chapter. The frozen Erlang corpus includes both numbers and null, so the value cannot be assumed mandatory or universally comparable.
untyped-chapter_number.disposition: Retain number versus null exactly and keep any numbering basis unknown unless a source-specific record supplies it.

untyped-chapter.definition: Legacy chapter is the recorded chapter title, not a stable identifier. It remains text even where a chapter_number accompanies it.
untyped-chapter.disposition: Preserve the title without deriving a hierarchy, canonical chapter ID, or equivalence across editions.

source-locator-context_hint.definition: context_hint is human-readable disambiguating context around an address, not the address itself or an authority for source support.
source-locator-context_hint.disposition: Keep the hint separate from typed coordinates; absence remains explicit and a matching hint does not resolve identity or support.

source-locator-locator_type.definition: locator_type declares how locator_value is to be interpreted, such as a page, anchor, or line span; the PDF and EPUB examples demonstrate that coordinate kinds differ.
source-locator-locator_type.disposition: Require a declared kind before interpreting the value; do not compare values across locator types or claim support.

source-locator-locator_value.definition: locator_value is the raw coordinate under locator_type, such as a page label, anchor, or line range.
source-locator-locator_value.disposition: Preserve the literal coordinate with its type and resource; it is not self-sufficient identity, basis, mapping, or claim support.

source-locator-mapping_evidence_refs.definition: mapping_evidence_refs identifies evidence that an original coordinate and a prepared counterpart correspond. It is correspondence provenance, not an address.
source-locator-mapping_evidence_refs.disposition: Record only inspected mapping evidence; an empty or unavailable list leaves correspondence unverified and never turns a locator into source support.

source-locator-numbering_basis.definition: numbering_basis states the sequence and base used by a locator, such as physical PDF page, printed label, converter index, or one-based output lines.
source-locator-numbering_basis.disposition: Keep the basis with the coordinate; do not infer offsets or equate same-looking numbers across sequences.

source-locator-original_locator_ref.definition: original_locator_ref points to a locator record for the preserved original representation, when one is known.
source-locator-original_locator_ref.disposition: Keep an unavailable original counterpart explicit; do not fabricate a target or claim that a prepared coordinate resolves back to source.

untyped-pdf_page.definition: Legacy pdf_page is an observed page coordinate. The music corpus is numeric while many Erlang cards record null; the Accent Types body also uses different page references, so its basis is not established by the field alone.
untyped-pdf_page.disposition: Preserve numeric versus null and do not calculate offsets, treat it as printed/physical/converter page, or use it as claim support.

source-locator-prepared_locator_ref.definition: prepared_locator_ref points to a locator record for a derived/prepared representation, when one is known.
source-locator-prepared_locator_ref.disposition: Keep preparation coordinates distinct from original coordinates and do not infer that their presence proves mapping or support.

source-locator-prepared_source_refs.definition: prepared_source_refs retains references to the prepared source, manifest, caveats, or related preparation provenance.
source-locator-prepared_source_refs.disposition: Retain preparation lineage separately from source identity and claim support; an empty list records no references, not successful preparation.

source-locator-range_convention.definition: range_convention states endpoint semantics for a span, such as inclusive output lines; the external map uses one-based inclusive source ranges.
source-locator-range_convention.disposition: Preserve inclusion and base rather than silently converting spans; a range does not establish a claim's evidentiary support.

source-locator-representation.definition: representation identifies the form being addressed, for example original PDF, EPUB-derived Markdown, or another prepared output.
source-locator-representation.disposition: Do not collapse representations into one source or infer byte identity from shared titles and locations.

source-locator-resource.definition: resource identifies the file or URI within the selected source snapshot or representation.
source-locator-resource.disposition: Keep the resource path/URI with the snapshot and representation; a resource alone neither fixes source identity nor supports a claim.

untyped-section.definition: Legacy section is the recorded finer-grained heading; the census contains both strings and null.
untyped-section.disposition: Preserve the heading or null without manufacturing a section record or inferring that null means no relevant span.

source-locator-source_ref.definition: source_ref identifies the source record to which a locator belongs, separate from its captured bytes and address.
source-locator-source_ref.disposition: Use it for source-record linkage only; do not substitute a title, locator, or snapshot and do not infer source support.

untyped-source_slug.definition: Legacy source_slug is a local source-family lookup label, distinct from the displayed source title and insufficient to identify an edition or frozen bytes.
untyped-source_slug.disposition: Retain the label as observed; do not promote it to a globally resolvable source or snapshot identifier.

source-locator-source_snapshot_ref.definition: source_snapshot_ref identifies the specific captured bytes or edition/capture record that anchors a locator.
source-locator-source_snapshot_ref.disposition: Keep snapshot identity distinct from source_ref and resource; when unavailable, record the limitation rather than asserting reproducibility.

untyped-source.definition: Legacy source is the displayed source title. It identifies neither a particular edition nor the snapshot used for extraction.
untyped-source.disposition: Preserve the title text and keep edition, capture, and support status unresolved.
